units.source_text: 叶子总是在厨房里帮忙，从没赴宴陪过客。

en.t: Yoko always helped in the kitchen and had never gone to a banquet to attend to the guests.

units.source_text: 客人多了，厨房里女佣的声音也大起来，可却没有听到叶子那优美的声音。

en.t: When there were more guests, the maids' voices in the kitchen grew louder too, but he did not hear Yoko's beautiful voice.

units.source_text: 负责岛村房间的那个女佣说，叶子有睡前入浴，在浴池里唱歌的怪癖，但他从没有听见过。

en.t: The maid in charge of Shimamura's room said Yoko had the odd habit of bathing before bed and singing in the tub, but he had never heard her.
